custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
  • Have a text of 300 characters ready to paste: 1234567890 written 30 times in a row (30 × 10 = 300).
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154797-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154797-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 2:

  • Inactive is picked.

Step 3:

  • The confirmation opens; its note field is labelled "Note (Optional)".

Step 4:

  • The field stops taking characters at 255: it ends with 25 full blocks of 1234567890 and then 12345 (25 × 10 + 5 = 255).

Step 5:

  • Part A leaves the Active tab.

Step 6:

  • Part A is listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 7:

  • The newest entry reads "Deactivated | Reason: " followed by the 255 characters, ending 12345.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R10: “The confirmation has a note field labelled "Note (Optional)". It stops accepting input at 255 characters.”
  • S10-R17: “The entry reads "Deactivated" or "Activated". When the user gave a note it reads "Deactivated | Reason: {note}" or "Activated | Reason: {note}". With no note it reads "Deactivated" or "Activated" and nothing more.”
